about.title: About Battle Pack 2: War of the Giants
paragraphs: Battle Pack 2: War of the Giants is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG pack released on 28 June 2013, in the ZEXAL era. It has 215 cards, and with the 212 other rarities there are 427 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 215 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 427, adding the 212 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
